title: Country Houses
setting: English country houses, provincial towns, Brighton, and London
summary: Draft summary — to be completed after transcription and review.
omitted_from_reading: The title pages and printer’s imprints of Volumes II and III, and the printed errata leaves of all three volumes, are in the JSON only.
notes_on_text: Published anonymously in 1832 in three volumes, combined here into a single digital edition with each volume presented as a part keeping its own chapter numbering.

A handwritten provenance note on the front flyleaf of the University of Illinois copy by Robert Henry Hobart Cust identifies the author as his great-grandmother, Mrs. Richard Moore (née Charlotte Trimmer, 1763–1836, eldest daughter of Sarah Trimmer).
Corrections from the three printed errata leaves (Volumes I–III) are applied in the text and marked as editorial corrections in the JSON.
